$$

To compute the dot product, we add up the products of corresponding components:

$$
\begin{aligned}(\frac{1}{2}a)\cdot b & =2\cdot 5+(-1)\cdot (-3)+1\cdot 1+3\cdot 0+5\cdot 2 \\  & =10+3+1+0+10 \\  & =24\end{aligned}
